summary: #poetryport #smallpoems #clmooc For first time since 8th grade I don't have a paradox no three hole Gibsons shining black suede or cherry read no 10 hole steel cap boots to keep bullies at bay each lace pull protection against harsh world
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#poetryport #smallpoems #clmooc
For first time since 8th grade
I don't have a paradox
no three hole Gibsons
shining black
suede or cherry read
no 10 hole steel cap boots
to keep bullies at bay
each lace pull protection
against harsh world
